{{Quote|The Empire's data network reports an Imperial fleet has recently been dispatched to that system. It appears to be a trap of some kind.|AP-5 warns Chopper of the Imperial blockade over Berzite|<ref name="TFD" />}}
'''Berzite''' was a [[planet]] in [[Wild Space]]'s [[Yost system]] that, in [[3 BBY]], was [[blockade]]d by the [[Galactic Empire]] in anticipation of rebel activity. As the rebel [[Phoenix Cell]] searched for a location for their new base, they initially declared one of [[Berzite's moon]]s as a viable option until the [[C1-series astromech droid|astromech droid]] [[C1-10P|Chopper]] and his new ally [[AP-5]] alerted them of the Imperial blockade there.

==Description==
Berzite was a [[planet]]<ref name="TFD concept gallery">{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/the-forgotten-droid-concept-art-gallery|text="The Forgotten Droid" Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slide 8}}</ref> with at least [[Berzite's moon|one moon]]. It was located in the [[Yost system]],<ref name="TFD" /> lying in [[Wild Space]] and within the area designated U-8 on the [[Standard Galactic Grid]].<ref name="Galaxy Map" />

==History==
[[File:The_Forgotten_Droid_thumb.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Chopper and AP-5 collaborated to alert Phoenix Cell of the Imperial presence over Berzite.]]
In [[3 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{RebelsDate|219}}</ref> the [[Galactic Empire]] [[blockade]]d Berzite with six [[Star Destroyer]]s. As the rebel [[Phoenix Cell]] searched for a secure world to house a new base, they cross-referenced old [[Galactic Republic|Republic]] and [[Lasat]] [[star map]]s and found that Berzite's [[moon]] was a suitable option. However, the rebel [[Phoenix Nest|cruiser-carrier]] did not have enough [[fuel]] to make the journey. Thus, the rebel team known as the [[Spectres]] traveled to [[Horizon Base]] to [[Heist at Horizon Base|steal]] the necessary fuel.<ref name="TFD" />

There, the [[C1-series astromech droid|astromech droid]] [[C1-10P|Chopper]] was separated from the team and stowed away aboard an [[Class four container transport|Imperial cargo ship]]. Chopper befriended the [[inventory droid]] [[AP-5]], who helped to commandeer the [[Transport|vessel]]. Upon hearing that the rebels planned to station their base on Berzite's moon, AP-5 warned them that the Empire had recently blockaded Berzite in anticipation of their move. Phoenix Cell ultimately staged their base on<ref name="TFD" /> the planet [[Atollon]] instead.<ref name="TFD Trivia">{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/the-forgotten-droid-trivia-gallery|text="The Forgotten Droid" Trivia Gallery}} {{C|Slide 6}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Berzite-Planet-Hologram-Concept-Art.png|thumb|right|280px|Berzite concept art by Sean Burke.]]
Berzite first appeared in a [[hologram]] in "[[The Forgotten Droid]],"<ref name="TFD" /> the nineteenth episode in the [[Star Wars Rebels Season Two|second season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]''. The episode premiered on [[March 16]], [[2016]].<ref name="Forgotten">{{WebCite|url=http://affiliate.zap2it.com/tv/star-wars-rebels/EP018796240050?aid=dxd|text=Star Wars Rebels: The Forgotten Droid|work=Disney XD Official Schedule|archivedate=20160407071629}}</ref> Although not identified in the episode,<ref name="TFD" /> Berzite was named in the accompanying episode guide. The design of Berzite's holographic appearance was a retextured asset of a previously existing model of the planet [[Lothal]]. The illustration was completed by concept artist [[Sean Burke]] by [[March 25]], [[2015]].<ref name="TFD concept gallery" />
